question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank 5.
solution:
The correct answer is** "appreciate."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Appreciate"** means to value or admire something or someone. (किसी व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु के गुण पहचानना और उन्‍हें महत्व देना; रसास्‍वादन करना)

 
 
• **Example**:* I **appreciated__** your help very much.*
 
 
 
• It is the most suitable option to fill in the blank.
 
• The sentence could mean that someone or something is valued or admired, and therefore does not need to be replenished, worshipped, or favored.
 
• The correct answer is option 4.
 
• **Correct passage**:

......Their ubiquity and durability have allowed them to survive for centuries, providing a window into the past for future generations to explore and__** appreciate**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **"Replenish"** means to refill or restore something that has been used up. ((कुछ) भरना या पूरा करना; पुनर्भरण करना)
 
• **"Worship"** means to show devotion or reverence to a deity or object of worship. ((की) पूजा करना (परमेश्‍वर या किसी देवता से विनती करना या उसके प्रति सम्‍मान प्रदर्शित करना), आराधना करना)
 
• **"Favour" **means to show kindness or preference towards someone or something. (को समर्थन देना; अधिक पसंद करना)
